entities.summary: Jürgen Schlegel is a German boxer. He competed at the 1964 Summer Olympics and the 1968 Summer Olympics. At the 1964 Summer Olympics, he defeated Henry Mugwanya of Uganda before losing to Cosimo Pinto of Italy.
